findings.reason: The cited evidence shows the alarm and maintenance but does not establish the causal link between the link failure and the site outages.
The evidence explicitly states the alert started at 05:30 and affects three specific sites.
The evidence confirms a critical LINK_LOS alarm on LNK-SFX-01-B raised at 05:41.
The cited alarms confirm SITE_DOWN status for all three sites at 05:42.
The evidence lists the maintenance window as 07:04 to 10:35 on LNK-SFX-01-B.
